name: Lake Erie ridge, Cleveland
notes: Window crosses north. speed_min and speed_max (hard max; good max is 12) are working assumptions. Gust limit is the USHPA P3 recommendation.

name: Tennessee cliff launch
notes: Central time. Ideal direction 260-280; confirm direction and speed limits with the club. Stability check wanted but not scored yet.

name: Canaan Valley Resort State Park
notes: WV. Chairlift launch ~300 ft S of top of Ski Lift A (coords: Paragliding Earth #21300). Direction window is the 45-degree cross rule; speed 0-15 from club page (min not confirmed). Park allows gusts to 20; using the stricter P3 limit of 18. Not confirmed with the club.

name: Richmond Dale
notes: OH. Ridge/thermal launch facing SW; tight sloped takeoff surrounded by trees (Paragliding Earth #7343). Ohio Flyers membership needed for gate key. PGE: needs very specific wind speed and direction; not a beginner site. Wind criteria unknown.

name: Wes-Mar Airfield
notes: OH. Grass runway, scooter towing for paragliders (Paragliding Earth #13558); PGE lists NE/E and SW/W runway directions. Ohio Flyers membership needed. Towing criteria differ from launch sites; wind criteria unknown.

name: High Point
notes: MD, Mountaineer HGA. Launch faces NW; Allegheny ridge, Allegany County, private road. Coordinates unknown (not on Paragliding Earth; club guide gives none). P3 plus thermal experience; sensitive site, club officer must guide. Criteria from club pages, not confirmed.

name: Zirk's
notes: MD, Mountaineer HGA. Faces NW but no direction window published. Speed conflict: sites page 0-15, site guide 4-12 for paragliders (using stricter). Gust limit unknown. Coordinates unknown. Sensitive site, club officer must guide.

name: Spruce Knob
notes: WV, Mountaineer HGA (per CHGPA page). Not researched. Coordinates unknown.

name: North Mountain
notes: WV, Mountaineer HGA (per CHGPA page). Not researched. Coordinates unknown.

name: Avonmore
notes: PA, Daedalus HGC. SW launch per ~18-year-old forum post (unverified). Three waivers: launch, right-of-way, LZ. Coordinates unknown.

name: Templeton
notes: PA, Daedalus HGC. NW launch per old forum post (unverified); appears active (July 2026 article). One waiver. Coordinates unknown.

name: Hyner View
notes: PA, Hyner HGC. Faces S, best in SE to SW. Coordinates: Paragliding Earth #14496. Speed source says '<15 km/h' (unit questionable). Club membership and waiver required; experienced pilots recommended.

name: The Pulpit (near McConnellsburg)
notes: PA, owned by CHGPA. Coordinates: Paragliding Earth #7349. PGE: launch faces SW/W/NW; not flown in a north cross (rotor); gets blown out easily; PG pilots don't fly if surface wind is over 7 mph (often over 15 at launch).

name: Bill's Hill (near Breezewood)
notes: PA. E launch per old forum post; PGE lists NE/E/SE. Coordinates: Paragliding Earth #15369. Notify Buchanan State Forest before flying. PGE: friendly P2 site, sometimes overgrown; LZ can be a long glide.

name: Jack's Mountain (near Lewistown)
notes: PA, Hyner HGC (per CHGPA page). SE launch per old forum post. Coordinates: Paragliding Earth #20241 'Jack's', likely but unconfirmed match (no details on PGE).
